attributes.title: Parallax
attributes.lede: One scroll value, five different rates.

lesson.concept: Several mappings can give one scroll value depth
lesson.why: Each layer derives a transform from the same progress source. Different travel distances and rotations create relative motion without needing separate scroll listeners for every layer.
lesson.experiment: Compare Deep layers and Gentle depth at the same scroll position. Stop scrolling and inspect whether the resulting composition remains readable.
lesson.pitfall: Large transforms can move essential text outside the reading area; depth should not hide the content it is meant to explain.
lesson.combine: Combine with reveal for discrete arrivals while continuous layers remain scroll-driven.
